criteria.requirement: International candidates must be non-Chinese citizens; no other nationality is excluded, so a DRC citizen is not excluded.
criteria.applicant: Citizen of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
criteria.quote: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport.

criteria.missing: Whether the applicant holds a valid passport.
criteria.quote: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport.

criteria.requirement: A bachelor's degree in any field (or a bachelor's diploma expected by August of the enrolment year).
criteria.applicant: Bachelor's degree (Licence) in Business Administration, obtained in 2024.
criteria.quote: Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in any field

criteria.requirement: No enrolment in another degree programme while studying at Peking University.
criteria.applicant: Not recorded as enrolled in any degree programme.
criteria.quote: Peking University does not allow students to be enrolled in other degree programs whilst studying at the university.

criteria.requirement: No strict age cut-off (the FAQ adds that nobody over 29 has been admitted, Zhuoyue Scholarship recipients excepted).
criteria.applicant: Recorded as under 30; there is no formal age limit to meet.
criteria.quote: We do not have a strict age cut-off for applicants

criteria.requirement: IELTS Academic 7.0, TOEFL iBT overall 5 or Cambridge English Scale 185, taken after 1 September 2025 and sent directly by the test body; exempt if English is the native language or the degree was taught in English.
criteria.applicant: No IELTS, TOEFL or DELF score recorded; the language of instruction of the degree is not recorded.
criteria.missing: An English test result at the required level sent before 30 November 2026, or proof of an English-taught degree.

criteria.requirement: Two recommendation letters written by full or associate professors in the intended field of study.
criteria.missing: Whether two full or associate professors in the intended field can recommend the applicant.
criteria.quote: Peking University will only accept recommendation letters written by full professors or associate professors (or equivalent titles).

funding.conditions: First academic year through the Yenching Fellowship; the second-year fellowship must be applied for (good academic standing, staying in Beijing).
funding.quote: All admitted students receive the Yenching Fellowship for the first academic year, which covers tuition

funding.conditions: First year in the Yenching Academy House on campus; second-year housing support only with the second-year fellowship.
funding.quote: accommodation in the Yenching Academy House

funding.conditions: A travel stipend for one round trip; the base city must be in the country of nationality and the cost is estimated and calculated by the Academy.
funding.quote: a travel stipend for one round-trip journey between your base city and Beijing

funding.conditions: Basic medical insurance, first year (and second year with the second-year fellowship).
funding.quote: basic medical insurance, a monthly stipend, and expenses related to research

funding.conditions: Monthly stipend; the amount is not stated on the pages read.
funding.quote: basic medical insurance, a monthly stipend, and expenses related to research

funding.conditions: Research expenses and field study costs (a week-long field study trip is a required course).

out_of_pocket: Unknown: the pages read give no amounts. Not covered on the pages read: an English test if one is needed, visa costs, and second-year costs if the second-year fellowship is not granted.
